metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare surface water extent between March 2019 and March 2018 - Location: Area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha, Nebraska - Use Sentinel-2 for good resolution and water detection - Time periods: March 2019 and March 2018 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get clear water detection - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water - Threshold NDWI > 0 to identify water pixels 3. Logic: - Calculate water area for both time periods - Compare if 2019 water area > 2018 water area - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels Approach: - Define polygon between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha - Get Sentinel-2 imagery for March 2018 and March 2019 - Calculate NDWI and threshold to identify water - Count water pixels for each period - Compare the counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry - Area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-96.3, 41.2], [-96.0, 41.2], [-96.0, 41.4], [-96.3, 41.4], [-96.3, 41.2] ]]); // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for water detection function getMarchCollection(year) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(year + '-03-01', year + '-03-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); } const col2018 = getMarchCollection('2018'); const col2019 = getMarchCollection('2019'); // Check for empty collections const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 March Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`2019 March Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create median composites and calculate NDWI function calculateWaterArea(collection) { const composite = collection.median(); // Calculate NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) const ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water mask (NDWI > 0 indicates water) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); return waterCount.getInfo(); } const water2018 = calculateWaterArea(col2018); const water2019 = calculateWaterArea(col2019); console.log(`2018 Water Pixels: ${water2018}`); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${water2019}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (water2018 === 0 || water2019 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (water2018 === null || water2019 === null || isNaN(water2018) || isNaN(water2019)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Final comparison const increase = water2019 > water2018; const percentChange = ((water2019 - water2018) / water2018 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Water change: ${percentChange}%`); if (increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
